label: post-hoc (fold 2 only; fold 1 reuses the champion's own committed validation numbers)
note: LightGBM reuses the frozen champion's exact hyperparameters AND exact tree count (273) in fold 2 - there is no non-test holdout left within 2012-2014 to early-stop against without using test for a design decision, so the champion's already-chosen tree count is reused directly instead of re-running early stopping. The scorecard reruns its full pipeline (WOE binning, IV filter, correlation reduction, VIF reduction, sign-correction logistic regression) on each fold's own train data; fold 2's final feature set is allowed to differ from the frozen scorecard's 17 features.
